coordinate_contract.origin: Midpoint of observed inner eye corners; if those are unavailable, midpoint of measured eye centers with origin_variant recorded. Never switch variants silently.

axes.x: Unit vector from anatomical right eye to anatomical left eye.
axes.y: Superior face direction projected orthogonally to x and normalized.
axes.z: cross(x,y), verified to point anterior/outward using measured mesh normal. Reject incompatible orientation rather than silently swapping side labels.

coordinate_contract.anatomical_left_right: Always subject-based; canonical x positive is anatomical left. Viewer left/right are not side identifiers.
coordinate_contract.display_mirroring: Apply preview mirror and crop once at final projection; never mirror landmarks a second time.

normalizers.face_width: Measured lateral facial surface span in the canonical plane, excluding hair/hijab/ears; record the measurement method.
normalizers.eye_width: Distance between observed inner and outer eye corners for that side.
normalizers.observed_brow_width: Lateral span of observed brow contour in the canonical frame.
normalizers.observed_brow_arc_length: Arc length of robust observed brow centerline.

image_to_surface_pipeline: Record image orientation, intrinsics, timestamp, detector space, preview crop and mirror metadata.
Convert detector points into unmirrored sensor coordinates using that exact orientation.
Use calibrated camera rays and measured mesh/depth to bind eligible skin points.
Do not ray-cast a pupil through an eye mesh hole as though it were skin. Eye-center transform or a separately validated depth method is required.
Construct canonical face frame, generate design region, bind to current skin triangles, then project to display.
coordinate_contract.surface_attachment: Barycentric triangle weights plus topology/model fingerprint; positions update from current measured vertices.
coordinate_contract.superior_direction_input: Verified anatomical-up direction from measured face pose, or observed forehead-to-chin geometry. If neither is available, fail frame construction; do not guess screen up.

adapters.metric_scale: Read from verified native adapter; do not infer from screen pixels.
Requires calibrated metric lifting or a compatible measured mesh; normalized coordinates alone do not satisfy metric inputs.

optional_formula_contract.nose_eye_rays: Use only as optional tutorial annotations when actual nose/eye observations and intersections are valid.
